name: file_preview_viewer_load_ready
zh: 当前加载尝试取得可用的预览渲染器代码导出；耗时从调用 import 到导出可用，不代表内容呈现。
en: The current import attempt yields usable preview viewer code exports; time from import invocation to usable exports, excluding content rendering.

name: file_preview_viewer_load_fail
zh: 当前预览渲染器代码加载拒绝或缺少所需导出；后续错误边界沿用该 incident，不再另立故障。
en: The current preview viewer code load rejects or lacks the required export; a later boundary capture reuses this incident.

name: file_preview_editor_load_ready

name: viking_bot_composer_load_fail

en: The current message list code load rejects or lacks the required export; a later boundary capture reuses this incident.

name: file_preview_image_load_ready
zh: 当前正文图片可用（load）；从为当前资源绑定 src 计时。缓存命中仍须确认当前元素有效。
en: The active inline preview image is available (load). Time from assigning the active source; verify cached element readiness.

name: file_preview_image_load_fail
zh: 当前正文图片元素触发 error；关闭的大图弹窗、过渡后台层和过期资源不报；不据此推断 HTTP 状态。
en: The active inline preview image element reports an error. Exclude closed dialogs, background transition layers and stale sources; do not infer HTTP status.

name: file_preview_video_metadata_load_ready
zh: 当前视频元数据可用（loadedmetadata）；从为当前资源绑定 src 计时。缓存命中仍须确认当前元素有效；视频不代表可连续播放。
en: The active video metadata is available (loadedmetadata). Time from assigning the active source; verify cached element readiness. Video metadata does not establish continuous playback readiness.

name: file_preview_video_metadata_load_fail
zh: 当前视频元数据元素触发 error；关闭的大图弹窗、过渡后台层和过期资源不报；不据此推断 HTTP 状态。
en: The active video metadata element reports an error. Exclude closed dialogs, background transition layers and stale sources; do not infer HTTP status.

name: file_preview_image_dialog_ready
zh: 当前大图弹窗图片可用（complete && naturalWidth > 0）；从打开弹窗计时。缓存命中仍须确认当前元素有效；视频不代表可连续播放。
en: The active dialog image is available (complete && naturalWidth > 0). Time from dialog activation; verify cached element readiness. Video metadata does not establish continuous playback readiness.

name: file_preview_image_dialog_fail
zh: 当前大图弹窗图片元素触发 error；关闭的大图弹窗、过渡后台层和过期资源不报；不据此推断 HTTP 状态。
en: The active dialog image element reports an error. Exclude closed dialogs, background transition layers and stale sources; do not infer HTTP status.

name: client_request_success
zh: Provider 管理的单次非流式 Client 请求完成响应体读取和现有业务错误判定；JSON/envelope/blob 共用一次尝试，不在 fetch 返回时提前报。
en: A Provider-owned non-streaming Client attempt finishes body consumption and existing business-error checks. JSON/envelope/blob share one attempt; fetch resolution alone is insufficient.

name: client_request_fail
zh: 同次请求在配置解析、传输、读体或既有业务错误判定失败；HTTP 200 错误外壳也失败。调用中止不报，合法非 JSON 响应不额外改判。
en: The attempt fails during configuration, transport, body consumption or existing business-envelope checks, including HTTP 200 error envelopes. Exclude aborts; do not newly reject legitimate non-JSON responses.

name: client_stream_connect_ready
zh: SSE 响应通过 HTTP、错误外壳、Content-Type 和 body 检查；从调用 stream 到连接可读，不代表首内容或正常结束。
en: The SSE response passes HTTP, error-envelope, Content-Type and body checks. Time from stream invocation to a readable connection; neither first content nor completion.

name: client_stream_connect_fail
zh: 连接阶段拒绝或协议条件不满足；主动取消排除。
en: Connection fails or violates the existing stream contract; exclude deliberate cancellation.

name: client_stream_read_complete
zh: 消费者实际读流并正常到达 EOF；从首次迭代到 EOF，包含消费者背压。正常终止事件后主动结束消费时不伪造 EOF。
en: The consumer reads to a normal EOF. Time from first iteration to EOF includes consumer backpressure. Do not fabricate EOF after the consumer stops on a terminal event.

name: client_stream_read_fail
zh: 已建立流在读取中抛出非取消异常；与连接错误分开。
en: An established stream throws a non-cancellation read error; distinct from connection failure.

name: task_poll_request_fail
zh: 一次任务查询故障连续期内，每个请求类故障类别首次出现时记录；后续同类别失败累计，不每 3 秒再报同一故障。
en: Record the first request-failure category in a contiguous polling outage; aggregate repeated failures of that category rather than reporting every poll.

name: task_poll_protocol_fail
zh: 查询结果 task id 不匹配或状态不在既有协议集合；同连续期同类别只记录首次，不改写任务状态。
en: A returned task ID mismatches or status violates the existing protocol; once per category per outage, without rewriting task status.

name: task_poll_recovered
zh: 连续查询故障后第一次取得有效响应；即使状态仍是 running 也算查询恢复。
en: The first valid response after a polling outage; recovery applies even if the task is still running.

name: file_browser_directory_load_ready
zh: 首轮或展开目录就绪；从实际发起目录加载，到当前目录结果规范化完成，首批行或空目录状态提交到对应 FileTree。
en: Initial or expanded directory is ready; measure from when a real directory load begins until the current directory is normalized and its first rows or empty state commit to the matching FileTree.

name: file_browser_directory_load_fail
zh: 首轮或展开目录在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: Initial or expanded directory has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: file_browser_preview_load_ready
zh: 资源预览就绪；从接受一次资源打开操作，到目标正文获取完成且前台 FilePreview 内容就绪。
en: Resource preview is ready; measure from when a resource-open operation is accepted until content is fetched and the foreground FilePreview is ready.

name: file_browser_preview_load_fail
zh: 资源预览在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: Resource preview has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

en: Session history has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: console_session_delete_success
zh: 会话删除完成；从内部删除会话调用开始，到服务按契约返回成功且本地列表处理完成，不因后续刷新失败改判。
en: Session deletion completes; measure from when the internal session-delete call starts until deletion succeeds under the service contract and local list handling finishes; later refresh errors do not reverse success.

name: console_session_delete_fail
zh: 会话删除在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: Session deletion has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: scope_cascade_libraries_load_ready
zh: 库选项就绪；从调用 loadLibraries，到当前祖先作用域下的库选项或空选项提交完成。
en: Library options is ready; measure from when loadLibraries is invoked until library options or an empty list commit for the current ancestor scope.

name: scope_cascade_libraries_load_fail
zh: 库选项在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: Library options has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: scope_cascade_spaces_load_ready
zh: 空间选项就绪；从调用 loadSpaces，到当前库下的空间选项或空选项提交完成。
en: Space options is ready; measure from when loadSpaces is invoked until space options or an empty list commit for the current library.

name: scope_cascade_spaces_load_fail
zh: 空间选项在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: Space options has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: scope_cascade_users_load_ready
zh: 用户选项就绪；从调用 loadUsers，到当前库和空间下的用户选项或空选项提交完成。
en: User options is ready; measure from when loadUsers is invoked until user options or an empty list commit for the current library and space.

name: scope_cascade_users_load_fail
zh: 用户选项在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: User options has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: file_preview_content_prepare_ready
zh: 前台预览内容准备就绪；从当前有效来源进入正文渲染路径，到当前前台层收到明确 ready 且加载遮罩结束；空文件可就绪，错误、unsupported、cleanup 均不算。
en: Foreground preview content preparation is ready; measure from when the current valid source enters content rendering until the foreground layer explicitly becomes ready and its loading overlay ends; empty files qualify, errors, unsupported states and cleanup do not.

name: file_preview_content_prepare_fail
zh: 前台预览内容准备在上述尝试中发生可观察的非取消失败；已有底层故障时沿用 incident 和 causeEventId；纯展示宿主 error props 不另立故障。
en: Foreground preview content preparation has an observable non-cancellation failure in that attempt; reuse the underlying incident and causeEventId. Merely displaying host error props does not create an incident.

name: console_chat_first_content_ready
zh: 从接受发送到收到并转换首段非空 text/reasoning/tool 内容；complete 携带首段正文也算。每次回复最多一次，不等于浏览器 paint。
en: Time from accepted send to the first normalized nonempty text/reasoning/tool content, including first content carried by complete. Once per reply; not browser paint.

name: console_chat_reply_complete
zh: 收到协议终态 complete 并合并回复完成；从接受发送计时。成功持久化不是前置条件；正常空回复不伪造首内容样本。
en: A protocol complete terminal is received and the reply is reconciled. Time from accepted send; persistence is independent and empty replies do not fabricate a first-content sample.

name: console_chat_reply_fail
zh: 会话准备、事件转换或回复协议失败，包括 EOF 先于终态；已有传输故障时仅关联传播。主动取消和 interrupted 排除。
en: Session preparation, event conversion or reply protocol fails, including EOF before a terminal. Link existing transport incidents. Exclude deliberate cancellation and interrupted terminals.

name: console_chat_history_save_fail
zh: 库本来会捕获的历史持久化失败；回复已完成仍保持完成。宿主接管的未知持久化不推断。
en: History persistence fails at a library-observed persistence boundary. A completed reply stays complete. Do not infer failures inside opaque host persistence.
